name: Tarczynski S.A.
summary: Tarczynski S.A. processes, produces, distributes, and sells meat and sausage products in Poland. It offers Kabanos sausages, including protein and plant-based ones; Tarczynski Naturally, meat without preservatives; cold cut; sausage products under the FRANKFURTERS name; Beef Jerky and Strips under the Protein name; meat snacks for children under the Gryzzale name; plant-based sausages; and cure meat products. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Trzebnica, Poland.
